The '''Thoadeye system''' was a part of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[thoadeye-style makeup]].<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Thoadeye-style makeup]]|system=Thoadeye [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thoadeye [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA" />
